title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 208 (When termination of agent’s authority takes effect as to agent, and as to third persons)

content.overview: The termination of the authority of an agent does not, so far as regards the agent, take effect before it becomes known to him, or, so far as regards third persons, before it becomes known to them.
content.glance: Termination effective as to agent only when known to him; as to third persons only when known to them.
content.study: The termination of the authority of an agent does not, so far as regards the agent, take effect before it becomes known to him, or, so far as regards third persons, before it becomes known to them.

sections.heading: As to the agent
sections.body: Termination does not take effect as regards the agent before it becomes known to him.

sections.heading: As to third persons
sections.body: Termination does not take effect as regards third persons before it becomes known to them.

provisions.title: When termination of agent’s authority takes effect as to agent, and as to third persons

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 208 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Separate agent knowledge from third-person knowledge; apply effective date accordingly.

examTips: Knowledge of agent vs knowledge of third persons.
